create_internvl_processor: create an InternVLProcessor instance with image processor, tokenizer, and optional video processor for multimodal input handling
process_multimodal_input: process interleaved text with image and video placeholders using InternVLProcessor to generate tokenized input with pixel values
insert_media_placeholders: insert media placeholders into text by replacing image and video tokens with appropriate token sequences and patch data
get_num_multimodal_tokens: compute the number of placeholder tokens needed for multimodal inputs given image sizes and configuration
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type IDs from input IDs to distinguish image tokens from text tokens
